scripts.build: npm run build --workspace server && npm run build --workspace web
scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace shared && concurrently -n server,web -c green,blue "npm run dev --workspace server" "npm run dev --workspace web"
scripts.migrate: npm run build --workspace shared && npm run migrate --workspace server
scripts.rotate-secret-key: npm run build --workspace shared && npm run rotate-secret-key --workspace server
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage --workspace server && npm run test:coverage --workspace web
